Lemma
[Laplacian of squared distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0274 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-volume-density-expansion 1. ch23:23.31\group Asymptotics

\[ \Delta _xd(x,y)^2=2n-\frac23R_{pq}(y)x^px^q- \frac12\nabla _rR_{pq}(y)x^px^qx^r+O(r^4). \]
Proof

\sketch Use $\Delta r=(n-1)/r+\partial _r\log \alpha $ and $\Delta r^2=2+2r\Delta r$, then differentiate the expansion for $\alpha $.

□
